## Houston 1.0.13

### What's new

- GPT-6.1 Terra is available when you connect your ChatGPT subscription.
- If you made your account with an email code, you can now also sign in with Google, Apple or Microsoft. Houston asks for a code sent to your email once, then links them.
- On yearly plans, the person who pays sees the price of a new seat before adding someone. The seat is charged right away, for the time left until renewal.
- On the web, Houston opens the space you used last, on any device.
- A task that runs for more than 4 hours now wraps up and keeps its work.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
